paragraphs.text: NInfer local inference provider and model manager for DeepSeek Harness
# NInfer for DeepSeek Harness
A local NInfer model provider for DeepSeek Harness. Import a folder to find `.ninfer` models, inspec
t their components and missing parts, and choose a model. The model's native context is selected whe
n its manifest declares it. Vision and MTP are enabled when present. NInfer requires an explicit dra
ft width for MTP, so the plugin uses the upstream automatic default of three drafts.
## Install
Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.2, Node 22.19+, Python 3.12+, Linux x86-64 and a compatible NVIDIA driver. In
**Plugins → Add plugin**, paste `https://github.com/averyjohnkucan-arch/dsh-ninfer` and enable it.
On consumer Blackwell GPUs (SM120), first activation downloads the **custom engine from this reposit
ory's GitHub release**, verifies every archive part and runtime file with SHA-256, and selects it au
tomatically. The package contains the matching server and calibration tool, CUDA and multimedia libr
aries, and a matching private glibc loader. No compiler, CUDA toolkit, old model folders or Desktop
launcher is needed. The host supplies the NVIDIA driver. The runtime download is approximately 1.5 G
iB; model weights are separate.
This custom runtime uses upstream revision `5ed86dff9fe3a5a0776f40a7aea86cf381da990d` plus the check
sum-pinned NVFP4 patch in this repository. It includes Q5_1/Q6_0 KV storage and embedding/output-hea
d residency controls used by the recovered NVFP4 profiles. Other previously supported NVIDIA GPUs re
tain the pinned official NInfer release; custom-only KV controls are not advertised for that fallbac
in the pinned official NInfer release; custom-only KV controls are not advertised for that fallback.
Progress, cancellation and retry appear in **Settings → Models → NInfer → Activity**. Existing runti
mes are preserved while a verified replacement is staged. Native GPU calibration defaults to the plu
gin's own data directory. Models are imported separately and stay where they are.
## Models and tuning
Choose **Import files**, open a folder and scan it. Complete models can be added; incomplete artifac
ts show their missing files. The plugin reads manifests and leaves weights in place. NInfer consumes
`.ninfer` artifacts. A GGUF must first be converted with NInfer's tools; it is not silently convert
r` artifacts. A GGUF must first be converted with NInfer's tools; it is not silently converted here.
NInfer automatically chooses resource settings and calibrates GPU kernels on first use when it has n
o matching device profile. **Save and calibrate** runs NInfer's native GPU calibration for the model
profile. NInfer does not have Strata's Thorough model tuner; calibration is not a full model-specif
ic optimization sweep. KV format options are NInfer's supported formats, not Strata's different K/V
imization sweep. KV format options are NInfer's supported formats, not Strata's different K/V pairs.
## Conversation checkpoints
**Advanced → Save conversation checkpoints** enables native disk snapshots for compatible models; it
defaults on for imported Qwen3.5-family artifacts. The plugin keeps up to 16 GiB per model, evictin
g least recently used snapshots first. The top-level **Purge all cache** button unloads plugin-manag
ed models and clears NInfer checkpoints while preserving profiles and weights.
Snapshot support and numerical behavior depend on the model and engine. Unsupported saves report a w
arning and fall back to normal prefill; the plugin does not report an unsuccessful save as a cache h
it. Checkpoints contain conversation state and live under `~/.dsh/dsh-ninfer/kv` (or `$DSH_HOME/dsh-
nts contain conversation state and live under `~/.dsh/dsh-ninfer/kv` (or `$DSH_HOME/dsh-ninfer/kv`).
## Development
`pnpm install --ignore-scripts`, `pnpm run check`, and `pnpm test`. `scripts/package-custom-engine.p
y` and the `custom-engine` workflow build the pinned source, verify the patched tree, and publish th
e relocatable runtime with checksums, source provenance and license notices. `scripts/build-checkpoi
nt-engine.js` is the optional local build path. Automatic installation downloads the published custo
m binary; it does not compile on the user's computer.
## Portable model configs
Use **Export config** beside a saved model, then **Download config JSON**. The export streams every
artifact piece through MD5; large models take time and progress appears in Activity. The JSON includ
es context, KV format, speculation, vision and checkpoint settings, plus the exact byte size and MD5
of each required piece. Model weights are not included.
Use **Import config**, select that JSON, and enter a model folder. The plugin searches its subfolder
s, checks exact size before MD5, and rebuilds the artifact’s relative shard layout using links. Rena
med or relocated files can be matched. Original weights remain in place. Runtime executables, creden
tials and machine-specific GPU calibration are not imported; calibrate again on the destination GPU.
Runtime downloads retry three times automatically. Bad checksums discard the damaged part before res
tarting it; interrupted transfers resume. A failed installation keeps a Retry button visible. Comple
te verified runtime folders are reused, and incomplete folders are preserved while a replacement is
fied runtime folders are reused, and incomplete folders are preserved while a replacement is staged.
Recovered configs preserve placement, host cache, graph, draft, output-limit and sampling settings.
Cache-stable history uses the bundled template; imported JSON cannot choose a template path or execu
table. On Blackwell, the automatically installed custom engine supports recovered Q5_1/Q6_0 KV profi
les; no executable selection is required. Advanced settings retain an optional executable override f
or other compatible builds.
Changing Context keeps an explicit KV capacity in sync when it tracked the old context or would be t
oo small for the new context. Automatic capacity and larger custom pools are preserved. Re-saving an
older profile repairs a capacity below its selected context without changing KV precision. Startup
failures show the engine's diagnostic instead of its usage manual.
Rename a saved model under **Settings → Model name → Save**. The name is used in the model list and
DSH model picker; its file paths, native model ID and tuning settings are preserved.
